For other uses, see [Happy Feet (disambiguation)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Happy_Feet_%28disambiguation%29). **Happy Feet** is a 2006 animated [jukebox musical](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jukebox_musical) [comedy film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Comedy_film) directed and produced by [George Miller](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Miller_%28filmmaker%29) and written by Miller, [John Collee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Collee), [Judy Morris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Judy_Morris) and Warren Coleman. It stars [Elijah Wood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elijah_Wood), [Robin Williams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robin_Williams), [Brittany Murphy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brittany_Murphy), [Hugh Jackman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugh_Jackman), [Nicole Kidman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicole_Kidman), [Hugo Weaving](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugo_Weaving), [Anthony LaPaglia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anthony_LaPaglia), [Magda Szubanski](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magda_Szubanski) and [Steve Irwin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Irwin). In the film, Mumble (Wood), a tapdancing [emperor penguin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emperor_penguin) who lacks the ability to sing a heartsong to attract a soulmate and is ridiculed by his peers and family, departs on a journey across Antarctica to learn what is causing the local fish population to decline.
